properties.name: TCS New York City Marathon (approximate course)
properties.finish: Tavern on the Green, Central Park, Manhattan
properties.fidelity: Approximate polyline of the published 5-borough route (not the surveyed centreline). The 45 waypoints trace the real landmarks (Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge, 4th Ave Brooklyn, Pulaski Bridge, Queensboro Bridge, 1st Ave, Willis Ave Bridge into the Bronx, Madison Ave Bridge, 5th Ave, Central Park drives). Measured as straight chords the polyline is ~37.4 km; the official surveyed course is 42.195 km. The ~5 km (12%) gap is street-grid curvature and small dog-legs a coarse polyline omits — the shape and borough sequence are faithful, the exact length is not.
properties.modeled_after: Provided for comparison with the Las Vegas Strip Marathon scenario (both officially 26.2 mi / 42.195 km). NYC is a point-to-point 5-borough course; Vegas is a Strip loop.
